title: Streetcar and Tram Systems — Core Overview (Edition 1)
description: Modern streetcars run on rails in mixed traffic or dedicated lanes, serving short downtown circulators and development corridors. They work best where frequent stops and visible permanence attract riders and investment. This overview edition presents Streetcar and Tram Systems as a core transit concept for contemporary cities.

principles: Design for frequency, speed, and reliability
Integrate fares and transfers across modes

real_examples.fact: Portland's streetcar loop helped catalyze Pearl District redevelopment.
